There are four types of Synthesis
including Forging, Medicine,
Decoration and Cooking.

＋Forging＋ is for making weapons
and tools. ＋Medicine＋ is for
making medicine.

＋Decoration＋ is for making armor
and accessories. ＋Cooking＋ is for
using implements to make food.

Think about what you want to make
and what you can make, and you'll
get the most out of Synthesis!

You can lean more Recipes by
eating ＋Cooking Bread＋.

However, you can't learn a new
recipe if your skill level is too
low.

In that situation, you'll need to
increase your Synthesis skill,
then try ＋Cooking Bread＋ again.

＋Cooking Bread＋ may be purchased
at restaurants.

The ＋RP Needed＋ for a specific
Synthesis will change depending
on the item and your skill.

If (and only if) your Max RP
exceeds the RP Needed for an
item, Synthesis is possible.

If your current RP isn't enough,
however, HP will be used to make
up the difference.

RP Needed decreases when you make
any item that's already been in
your possession previously.

If you make something without a
Recipe, however, the RP Needed
will increase.

You can gain more Exp when you
make something slightly beyond
your current skill level.

So try to make the most difficult
item you can with your current
skill. Always push the envelope!

If you put an ingredient into a
dish which is NOT in the Recipe,
it's known as an ＋Arranged Dish＋.

Arranged Dishes restore more HP
than regular dishes.
They also make you more powerful.

So if you have some extra ingre-
dients, try adding them to make
Arranged Dishes whenever you can!

It makes it more difficult to
cook, but you can get a lot
more Exp!

Just be careful not to cook
anything inedible...

The names of Arranged Dishes are
written in blue to distinguish
them from regular dishes.

Items made through ＋Forging＋
and ＋Decoration＋ are better than
what you can buy at the store.

If an item's name is written in
blue, it indicates that the item
differs from others in some way.

You might find blue-text items
from ＋treasure chests＋ in the
dungeon.

Besides Synthesis, you can
reinforce your equipment through
＋Forging＋ and ＋Decoration＋.

You can upgrade your equipment
by using certain specific items
on certain specific equipment.

Each equipment item can be
upgraded as high as level 10.

Reinforcing equipment is always
successful. You'll never lose an
item through a botched job.

In addition, there are several
items that can be used to add
unique effects.

As well as further enhancements
including the synthesis of spe-
cial abilities for accessories,

and alterations to a staff's
magic charge.

However, if you keep using the
same items to reinforce, it
becomes less and less effective.

Higher-level food and medicine
have a greater effect.

You can make higher-level items
by using higher-level 
ingredients.

It's important to keep your farm
clean. You can't plant crops or
water crops if you don't.

Mowing grass, chopping away
stumps and breaking rocks are
all part of cleaning the land.

There are a variety of ways to
clean.

After cleaning a farm, you can
cultivate with a ＋Hoe＋.

The area you cultivate looks
different. It's called ＋soil＋.
You can plant ＋seeds＋ in soil.

If you want to turn soil back to
flat land, use a hammer.

Seeds can only be planted in a
＋cultivated area＋ (meaning,
＋soil＋).

After equipping the desired
seeds, hold ＠字０＠ to sprinkle them
into the soil.

Areas you can seed will display
in ＋red＋.

If you make a mistake, though, no
worries! You won't lose any seeds
by using them in the wrong area.

It's also important to water
your crops.
